name: pixlings
description: A tiny pixel creature that lives above your Claude Code prompt. It counts down your prompt cache and guards it on model switches, wakes Claude when your usage limit resets, brings a helper for every subagent, makes sound on Windows and Linux, yelps before risky commands, rolls its eyes at "You're absolutely right", and brings back your old /buddy.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: all: every reaction makes a sound. important: only when Claude needs you, finishes a long turn, runs something dangerous or hits the limit. off: silent.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: full: the animated pixling, 9 rows. compact: 4 rows, drawn as a picture where the terminal draws images (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2 fullscreen), else as full. slim: 2 rows of picture, else as minimal. minimal: one line, a tiny picture where the terminal draws images, else a face. off: no band (sounds and notifications stay).

chatter.title: Chattiness
chatter.description: normal: it comments on what happens. quiet: only on failures, danger and when it needs you.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Notify the OS when Claude needs permission, finishes a long turn or the usage limit resets.

autoContinue.title: Continue after the usage limit resets
autoContinue.description: When the usage limit resets, the pixling wakes up and tells Claude to carry on.

vitals.title: Vitals row
vitals.description: Show the prompt cache countdown, cache hit rate, context fill and rate-limit windows under the pixling.

cacheWarning.title: Cache cooling warning
cacheWarning.description: A minute before the prompt cache expires, the pixling tells you (with a tick-tock) so a reply in time saves re-sending the whole context.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: assume five minutes until a request proves an hour. 5m or 1h: use that.

roam.title: Walk around
roam.description: When Claude is idle the pixling strolls along the free columns of the band.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: animalese: it says each line in its own made-up voice, a little syllable per letter at its species' pitch. speech: it reads its lines aloud with the system voice. off: no voice (event sounds stay).

quips.title: AI quips
quips.description: off: only the pixling's built-in lines; it never spends tokens. haiku: now and then (red tests, errors, big diffs, or when you say its name; at most once a minute) it asks Claude Haiku for a one-line quip of about 100 tokens, and shows what each one cost.

cacheGuard.title: Cache guard on model switch
cacheGuard.description: Before a /model switch throws away a warm prompt cache that would cost real money to write again, the pixling asks you to confirm.

heckle.title: Heckle in the transcript
heckle.description: Adds a faint eye roll and running count after Claude's "You're absolutely right" replies. Only the view changes; the saved conversation is untouched.
